what_changed: CFPB ANPR on raising the 12 CFR 1090 larger-participant threshold for the automobile financing market (currently 10,000 aggregate annual originations, about 63 nonbanks covering an estimated 94 percent of originations); one example threshold of 1,050,000 originations would leave five entities (about 42 percent of market activity). Comments due September 22, 2025.
rationale: Full text confirms the ANPR concerns only which nonbank auto finance companies the CFPB may supervise under 12 U.S.C. 5514(a)(1)(B); it changes no conduct obligation, and the underlying laws apply regardless of supervision. Not auto-closed because supervision scope affects exam exposure of auto-finance clients.
